title: 第一卷 第3章 林伯，我来给您暖床吧
slug: 满门遗孀花甲老汉粮肉满仓
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

林骁将三姐妹带进堂屋。

屋里炉火烧得正旺，驱散了她们一身寒气。

他倒了三碗热茶，苏馨月捧在手里，这才缓过神来，将方才的事细细说了一遍。

林骁听完，眉头微锁，起身说道：“我去看看。”

苏馨月下意识抓住他胳膊：“林伯，太晚了，又下着雪……算了吧。”

她的手冰凉，带着轻微的颤抖。

林骁望着她担忧的眼神，沉默片刻，坐回椅子上。

他点头：“也好，今晚你们安心睡这儿，明早再说。”

苏馨月缩回手，满脸歉疚：“林伯，这么晚还来打扰您……失礼了。”

“不碍事。”林骁起身去里屋柜子取被褥。

上官飞燕撇着嘴，眼神在屋里扫了一圈，虽嫌弃这屋子简陋，但外面风声呜咽，她缩了缩脖子，终究没吭声。

苏馨月帮着铺炕。

火炕烧得暖烘烘的，被子虽旧，但干净厚实。

“时候不早了，你们早点歇着。”林骁抱起原先的被褥，“我去偏房睡。”

“那怎么行，偏房没烧炕，这么冷的天……”苏馨月忙开口阻拦。

“你们身子单薄，睡冷炕哪受得了。”林骁笑了笑，“听话，睡吧。”

他话音刚落，院门外又传来“砰砰”的敲门声。

上官飞燕“啊”一声缩到苏馨月身后，脸都白了：“就、就是这个声音，是不是……是不是爹回来了？还没到头七呢……”

“别瞎说。”苏馨月揽住她，自己声音也在抖。

林骁脸色沉下来：“我去看看。”

“别去！”上官飞燕突然喊出声，又觉不妥，别过脸小声嘟囔，“你这老胳膊老腿的……万一……”

林骁看了她一眼。

这姑娘虽嘴硬，心倒不坏。

林骁温声道：“没事，我怀疑是有人装神弄鬼。”

他提了盏油灯，从门后抽出柴刀，拉开堂屋门。

寒风卷着雪沫扑进来，他迈步走进院子。

林骁提着灯照了照，雪地里几行脚印又深又乱。

他眉头微皱，关上门回到屋里。

林骁沉声道：“是有人装神弄鬼，等明天，我设个陷阱，替你们出气。”

上官飞燕长舒一口气，随即咬牙切齿：“可恶的家伙，别让我逮到！”

“好了，睡吧。”林骁安抚着，“我守着，你们安心睡。”

苏馨月眼圈泛红，低声道谢。

三人躺上炕。

被窝被火炕烘得暖融融的，上官飞燕忍不住舒服地叹了一声：“好暖和呀……”

“林伯的炕烧得真好。”苏馨月也轻声道。

“暖和就好，怕冷的话，柜子里还有床被子。”林骁一副慈祥的模样。

“不用不用，已经很好了。”苏馨月忙说。

“好了，我去偏房了，你们好好歇着。”

偏房果然冷得刺骨。

炕是凉的，窗户缝漏风。

林骁和衣躺下，旧被单薄，寒气从四面八方渗进来。

他辗转反侧，睡意全无。

正屋里，上官飞燕翻了个身，小声道：“苏姐姐，你和清雪姐睡吧，我守着，万一那老头子半夜溜进来……”

苏馨月伸手轻弹她额头：“你呀，总爱胡思乱想，快睡，我守着。”

“那你等下叫醒我，”上官飞燕嘟囔，“咱们轮流……”

“好。”苏馨月柔声应道。

不多时，飞燕的呼吸变得均匀绵长。

冷清雪本就体弱，也早已睡着。

苏馨月悄悄起身，披了外衣，端起油灯，轻手轻脚走到偏房门外。

Page (1/3)

Lin Xiao brought the three sisters into the main room.

The fire in the room was burning brightly, dispelling the coldness all over them.

He poured three bowls of hot tea, and Su Xinyue held it in her hands. Then she calmed down and explained what had just happened in detail.

After hearing this, Lin Xiao frowned slightly, stood up and said, "I'll go take a look."

Su Xinyue subconsciously grabbed his arm: "Uncle Lin, it's too late, it's snowing again... forget it."

Her hands were cold and trembling slightly.

Lin Xiao looked at her worried eyes, remained silent for a moment, and sat back on the chair.

He nodded: "Okay, you can sleep here tonight and talk about it tomorrow morning."

Su Xinyue retracted her hand with an apologetic look on her face: "Uncle Lin, I'm sorry to disturb you so late..."

"It's okay." Lin Xiao got up and went to get the bedding from the cabinet in the back room.

Shangguan Feiyan curled her lips and glanced around the room. Although she disliked the simplicity of the room, the wind whimpered outside, so she shrank her neck and did not say anything after all.

Su Xinyue helped lay the kang.

The heated kang was very warm, and the quilt was old but clean and thick.

"It's getting late, you guys should have a rest early." Lin Xiao picked up the original quilt, "I'll go to the side room to sleep."

"How can that be done? There is no kang in the side room. It's such a cold day..." Su Xinyue hurriedly stopped her.

"You are so weak that you can't stand sleeping on a cold bed." Lin Xiao smiled, "Be obedient and go to sleep."

As soon as he finished speaking, there was another "bang bang" knock on the door.

Shangguan Feiyan said "Ah" and shrank behind Su Xinyue, her face turned pale: "Just, that's the sound, is it... is dad back? It's not the first seven yet..."

"Don't talk nonsense." Su Xinyue hugged her, her own voice trembling.

Lin Xiao's face darkened: "I'll go take a look."

"Don't go!" Shangguan Feiyan shouted suddenly, but felt it was inappropriate, turned away and muttered in a low voice, "You have old arms and legs...what if..."

Lin Xiao glanced at her.

Although this girl has a tough mouth, she has a good heart.

Lin Xiao said warmly: "It's okay, I suspect someone is pretending to be a ghost."

He held an oil lamp, took out the hatchet from behind the door, and opened the main room door.

The cold wind blew in the snow foam, and he stepped into the yard.

Lin Xiao held up a lamp and looked at it. The footprints in the snow were deep and messy.

He frowned slightly, closed the door and returned to the house.

Lin Xiao said in a deep voice: "Someone is pretending to be a ghost. Wait until tomorrow and I will set a trap to vent your anger."

Shangguan Feiyan breathed a long sigh of relief, then gritted his teeth: "Damn you, don't let me catch you!"

"Okay, go to sleep." Lin Xiao soothed, "I'll watch over you, so you can sleep peacefully."

Su Xinyue's eyes were red and she thanked her in a low voice.

The three of them lay on the kang.

The bed was warmed by the fire, and Shangguan Feiyan couldn't help but sigh comfortably: "It's so warm..."

"Uncle Lin's kang burns really well." Su Xinyue also said softly.

"As long as it's warm, if you're afraid of the cold, there's a quilt in the cabinet." Lin Xiao looked kind.

"No, no, it's already very good." Su Xinyue said hurriedly.

"Okay, I'm going to the side room, you guys have a good rest."

The side room was indeed bone-chillingly cold.

The kang was cold, and the window was leaking air.

Lin Xiao lay down undressed. The old quilt was thin, and the cold air seeped in from all directions.

He tossed and turned, completely sleepless.

In the main room, Shangguan Feiyan turned over and whispered: "Sister Su, you and Sister Qingxue can sleep together. I'll keep watch in case that old man sneaks in in the middle of the night..."

Su Xinyue reached out and flicked her forehead: "You, you always like to think wildly, go to sleep quickly, I will watch over you."

"Then wake me up later," Shangguan Feiyan muttered, "Let's take turns..."

"Okay." Su Xinyue responded softly.

After a while, Feiyan's breathing became even and long.

Leng Qingxue was already weak and had already fallen asleep.

Su Xinyue stood up quietly, put on her coat, picked up the oil lamp, and walked quietly to the door of the side room.
